author: StewieFG
body:
Helloooooo and good evening/morning/ whatever it is for you! <3

Today I came up with another suggestion, but it's a bit hard for me to explain, but I hope you will understand.

Hosting a server costs money, and the bigger player amount possible the more money you pay for the hosting. Avicus maximum player amount that is possible is 750, which costs alot of money to host. In the past 4 months I have never seen In avicus more than 400 players. My suggestion is to reduce avicus play limit to 400, 450, or 500 players, and it will cost less. Every month Kylo will pay less, and with this money he could do better stuff like money for developing or designing website and money for the update, because I really don't see any reason why paying more money if it's not needed when this money could be used for better goals.
Opinions!
